audience: finance and billing teams that send and receive Peppol e-invoices through Recommand

useCases.title: Find invoices that failed to reach the buyer
useCases.text: List sent documents with failed delivery. Open one to read its parsed content and delivery status.

useCases.title: Work through the inbox
useCases.text: List the incoming documents that are not read yet. Open each one, then mark it as read so it leaves the inbox.

useCases.title: Check a Peppol address before you send
useCases.text: Look up a Peppol address in the directory. Read whether it is registered, its company name and the document types it accepts.

useCases.title: Send an invoice to a Peppol buyer
useCases.text: Verify the buyer first, then send an EUR invoice over Peppol or by email. A send cannot be undone. After a timeout, list the outgoing documents before any retry.

useCases.title: Review companies and labels
useCases.text: List the companies of the team with their Peppol registration status. List the labels of the team to filter documents by label.
